topics.title: Dawn of War IV Space Marines Faction Reveal
topics.what_is_driving_it: Official Space Marines faction trailers for Dawn of War IV are drawing high view velocity across IGN, the official channel and short-form clips.
topics.relevance_note: Three separate uploads from 30 Sep to 8 Oct are all trending, so the reveal is at peak attention. A breakdown of what the Space Marines faction brings to the game, and how its lore connects to the tabletop chapters, can ride that momentum.

topics.title: Tournament Organisers Banning Certain Bases
topics.what_is_driving_it: A tournament organiser's reaction and ban of a specific base design is generating heavy short-form engagement and debate about base rules.
topics.relevance_note: This hits a live tension in tournament play: how much base customisation is allowed and what counts as a legal base. Viewers are actively debating it in comments right now.
topics.gap_note: The coverage is mostly reaction clips with no clear explainer. A video covering the base rules, how TOs set them and how to build a compliant base would own the search and recurring-question space.

topics.title: Cursed Lego Space Marine Kitbash
topics.what_is_driving_it: A Lego Space Marine build is pulling strong velocity, showing audience appetite for unconventional kitbashing and non-standard materials.
topics.relevance_note: The short is pulling about 136k views a day and sits squarely in the hobby-build space. It makes a natural hook for a longer kitbash-process video.
topics.gap_note: There are plenty of viral Lego gag shorts but few well-documented build tutorials for 40K-scale Lego minis. A full build-along showing parts sourcing, scaling and paint would fill that gap.

topics.title: Wargaming Scenery and 11th Edition Terrain Builds
topics.what_is_driving_it: Scenery-focused Warhammer shorts are trending strongly, and Spikey Bits has published a ranked guide to 11th Edition terrain footprints and sets.
topics.relevance_note: Terrain is both a viral hobby format and a practical purchase question right now. Players moving into 11th Edition need to know which footprints and sets to buy.
topics.gap_note: Viral scenery shorts show strong demand but rarely go deep on process. A full terrain build covering footprint choice, base materials and table-ready finishing would stand out against both the shorts and the retail guides.

topics.title: Horus Heresy Rules Update Explained
topics.what_is_driving_it: Games Workshop published a Horus Heresy rules update on 12 Oct, a fresh change to the rules set players are using now.
topics.relevance_note: A rules update lands with immediate practical impact on play. Players will be searching for what changed, so a clear breakdown of the changes is timely.

topics.title: Chaplains Explained: Warhammer 40K Lore
topics.what_is_driving_it: A long-form Chaplains lore explainer from Majorkill is pulling 84k views a day, with strong audio-mention traction.
topics.relevance_note: Faction-role explainers are performing well as long-form lore content. Chaplains are a recognisable, debate-friendly subject for the account to take its own angle on.

topics.title: Warhammer Day 2026: Date, Exclusives and Rewards
topics.what_is_driving_it: Spikey Bits has published its Warhammer Day guide covering the date, in-store rewards and event exclusives.
topics.relevance_note: Players planning their event attendance will be searching for exclusives and reward details. Publishing a clear, scannable guide or reel before the event captures that search intent.

topics.title: Warhammer 40K MTG Commander Crossover Decks
topics.what_is_driving_it: Spikey Bits has published multiple Warhammer MTG Commander crossover guides covering Chaos, Tyranid and Necron decks, all updated this week.
topics.relevance_note: Several fresh decklist and card-by-card articles show sustained interest in the crossover, and collectors are watching prices and reprints.

topics.title: Necrons Suppress the Warp
topics.what_is_driving_it: A 40K Daily short on the Necrons' method for suppressing the Warp is pulling about 118k views a day.
topics.relevance_note: Warp-mechanic lore is a proven format for this audience. The Necron angle connects to current Necron releases and the MTG Necron Dynasties deck, widening its appeal.
